summary: TORONTO, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Allied Gold Corporation (TSX: AAUC; NYSE: AAUC) (“Allied” or the “Company”) is pleased to provide an update on the installation of full power supply infrastructure at the Kurmuk Mine. The Company is also progressing exploration and design activities at Tsenge to support its advancement and development as an additional mining area and source of ore for the mill.
title: Allied Gold Provides Update on Full Power Availability at Kurmuk, Advances Toward Commercial Production and Progresses Tsenge Areas Toward Development

summary: SELBYVILLE, Del., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FirstService Residential, the leading residential community management company in North America, is pleased to announce that it has been selected to provide full-service property management services for Swann Cove Property Owners Association in Selbyville, Delaware.
title: FirstService Residential Expands in Delaware, Welcoming Swann Cove Property Owners Association

summary: All amounts are in United States dollars, unless otherwise stated. TORONTO, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alamos Gold Inc. (TSX:AGI; NYSE:AGI) (“Alamos” or the “Company”) has been notified that Newcastle Capital Partners Inc. (“Newcastle”) has made an unsolicited mini-tender offer to purchase up to 2,500,000, or 0.60%, of the outstanding common shares of Alamos at a price of C$40.00 per share.
title: Alamos Gold Cautions Shareholders Regarding Newcastle Capital Partners' Mini-Tender Offer For Shares

summary: TORONTO, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sun Life Financial Inc. (TSX: SLF) (NYSE: SLF) ("Sunlife") announced today that it completed the redemption of all of its outstanding $500 million principal amount of Series 2021-1 Subordinated Unsecured 2.46% Fixed/Floating Debentures. About Sunlife Sunlife is a leading international financial services organization providing asset management, wealth, insurance and health solutions to individual and institutional Clients.
title: Sunlife redeems Series 2021-1 Subordinated Unsecured 2.46% Fixed/Floating Debentures

summary: CALGARY, Alberta, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Enerflex Ltd. (TSX: EFX) (NYSE: EFXT) (“Enerflex” or the “Company”) today announced the appointment of Christine Morris as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective January 1, 2027. Ms. Morris will succeed Preet S. Dhindsa, who will step down from his role effective December 31, 2026.
title: Enerflex Ltd. Announces CFO Transition
